gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-scope-one: Scope One brings a classic serif body with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, so its letters feel sturdy and spacious. And Snowburst One, cut like a stencil sheet with wide bridges, sits above it as the loud, tall-lowercase showpiece.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-slabo-13px: Dignified and bookish, Slabo 13px keeps its serif letters wide in the counters of a, e and s. But Snowburst One is the one built to shout, with stencil bridges and tall lowercase that a body face never attempts.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-suwannaphum: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges and a tall lowercase. That stencil punch is best when the words are big and short, while Suwannaphum, a serif with a wide-open c and a high x-height, carries the editorial side.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-epunda-slab: Pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase make Tektur look like a gadget label, with the same pen pressure from first letter to last. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a visibly gaping c, steps in beneath it and gives the page a dignified, rounded voice.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fauna-one: Pipe-cleaner strokes and bowls that never thin at the sides give Tektur a distinctive, almost engineered look. And Fauna One, a text serif with a tall middle band and short ascenders, would read as a literary, dignified voice across a long page.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-glegoo: Expressive from the first glance, Tektur draws every line at a steady, unvarying weight with openings on each curve. But Glegoo, a serif with big counters and unclosed curves, is what makes the pair refined and editorial.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-kadwa: Tektur traces its glyphs with a single thickness, giving pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase. But Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a larger x-height, is the one made for carrying words, while Tektur is made for announcing them.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noticia-text: Tektur draws a marker-like constant line, with oversized lowercase and open terminals on every curve. Noticia Text, a text serif with a big entrance into each curved letter, would read as literary and dignified over a long stretch.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-piazzolla: Pipe-cleaner strokes, one constant pen width, outsized lowercase: Tektur looks like a machine sketch. Piazzolla, a text serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, would feel crowded if the heading shrank, since Tektur loses its force at small sizes.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-pridi: Expressive and a bit odd, Tektur draws bowls and stems at the same weight, with open terminals everywhere. Pridi, a serif whose small letters stand almost capital-sized, can stay modest in size, since its curves already have room.
